cdc.title: CDC agency materials
cdc.download: Public official source URLs; original materials are available free from CDC.
cdc.transform: Separate Demeter analyses from unmodified agency originals.
conditions: Credit CDC/NCHS and display non-endorsement and free-source notices.
Preserve substantive source content. Label historical snapshots and derived analyses.
Third-party material, marks, and foreign rights require separate consideration.

nhanes.title: NCHS public-use survey data
nhanes.download: Public-use files only, under the NCHS data user agreement.
nhanes.transform: Statistical analysis/reporting with documented survey design, weights and transformations.
conditions: No identification, linkage to individually identifiable data, or research to defeat disclosure protections.
Credit CDC/NCHS; preserve public-use restrictions and source vintage with copies.
Public use does not authorize restricted NHANES or identifiable clinical records.

census.title: Census public statistical data and metadata
census.download: Public PEP/ACS data and metadata endpoints; API credentials stay private.
census.transform: Label Demeter transformations and preserve source definitions and vintage.
conditions: Census employee works generally have no U.S. copyright protection; foreign and third-party rights may differ.
Credit U.S. Census Bureau; this classification covers these public aggregate/metadata artifacts, not restricted microdata.

usda.title: USDA agency data
usda.transform: Attribute USDA ERS and document derived analyses.
conditions: USDA public-domain information may be copied with attribution; third-party exceptions remain applicable.
No agency endorsement or logo rights are conveyed.

niddk.title: NIDDK agency content
niddk.transform: Keep original archived HTML distinct from Demeter extracts and analyses.
conditions: Credit NIDDK. Majority of content is copyright free; third-party content/graphics have separate rights.
No logo or endorsement permission is conveyed; no remote images are bundled.

clinicaltrials.title: ClinicalTrials.gov database terms
clinicaltrials.download: Official public API; downloading is subject to the site terms.
clinicaltrials.transform: Describe modifications, cite registry IDs and preserve sponsor-submitted status.
conditions: Attribute ClinicalTrials.gov, retain processing date, describe modifications, and consult live records for updates.
These are explicitly historical snapshots, not a current clinical-trial directory. Terms call for current data in distributions; current-use republication requires checking/updating the live record.
Do not assert proprietary database rights or use extracted email addresses for promotion. International and third-party copyright can apply.

cc_by.title: Article-specific CC-BY attribution
cc_by.download: Public article under the article-specific license recorded in its receipt.
cc_by.transform: Cite authors, journal, DOI and license; identify extraction and changes.
conditions: Preserve attribution and license notice; article reuse rights do not grant access to underlying patient records.
Do not guess a Creative Commons version when the recorded notice only says CC-BY.

facts.title: Limited factual extraction; no article republication
facts.download: Obtain the linked article through a permitted publisher/public repository access route.
facts.transform: Only the cited numeric observations and Demeter-authored structure are redistributed.
conditions: Facts are distinguished from protected expression. This is not a license for the full article, figure, table layout, or other third-party content.
Preserve author/journal/DOI and exact extraction locator; re-evaluate rights before expanding the extraction.

article_fetch_only.title: Copyrighted article; no redistribution permission recorded
article_fetch_only.download: Obtain through authorized public/publisher access into ignored local storage; no bypass of access controls.
article_fetch_only.transform: Re-extract cited numeric facts with the pinned locator; do not republish article text.
conditions: No full-text redistribution permission is recorded for the ARIC article. The package contains citations, receipts and numeric facts only.
A public PMC URL is not a blanket redistribution license.
OSF node license metadata was null on inspection; the repository does not assert a redistribution license.
Raw author data/code and individual outputs are excluded from distributions. Reassess permission before proposing any raw redistribution.
Attribute the trial, archive version and corrections. Statistical reproduction is not clinical transport or a validated disease pathway.
author_trial_fetch_only.download: Author provides a public archive; obtain pinned bytes in ignored local research storage.
author_trial_fetch_only.title: Public author trial archive; no raw redistribution permission recorded
author_trial_fetch_only.transform: Demeter reproduces aggregate statistics without publishing participant records or executing author code.

dryad_cc0_public.title: Chen public data release CC0 dedication
dryad_cc0_public.download: Public CC0 workbook, no account or research agreement required.
dryad_cc0_public.transform: Reproducible aggregate statistical/source audits with provenance; no person-level exports.
conditions: Preserve source identity, population and vintage; cite authors.
Public data do not authorize identification or linkage to identifiable people.
Full article rights are separate from the dataset dedication.
